bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
u=gace-userbot-verify.service
test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u")" = active || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled "$u")" = enabled || exit 71
test -S "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" || exit 72
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock")" = 600 || exit 73
py="$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python"
client="$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
"$py" -B "$client" health || exit 74
"$py" -B "$client" bot_start_menu || exit 75
"$py" -B "$client" room_private_smoke || exit 76
"$py" -B "$client" health || exit 77

test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled "$u")" = enabled || exit 79

echo USERBOT_SERVICE_PRESERVED=YES
